question: Can a physical choke supply approximately 357.528 uH effective at operating bias, carrying the supplied envelope, without erasing the 19.38 W switching saving?

derived_ripple_basis.note: I_ac = dIpp/(2*sqrt(3)); I_dc = sqrt(I_rms^2 - I_ac^2). Reported for bookkeeping only; total RMS heating uses I_rms = 15.0 A per WORKER.md I_rms^2*R rule.

decision_rule: A candidate choke wins only if its increase in DC+AC+core loss over the retained Wurth 760800301 at this envelope is less than the switching saving (19.3765 W at 65 kHz).

digitization_method.what: L versus DC bias for each part read from datasheet page 2, 'Typical Inductance vs. Current Characteristics' (a graph; no tabulated L(bias) is published).
digitization_method.how: page 2 rendered at 600 dpi (pdftoppm); the left chart's grey gridlines (grey level ~137) calibrate x (0..xmax A) and y (0..YMAX uH); the pure-black (V<60) curve is traced column by column; L at a requested current is the median of traced columns within +/-0.6 A. Script: derived/digitize_l_curve.py; output: derived/l_vs_current_digitized.json.
digitization_method.uncertainty: One rendered pixel is ~0.17-0.34 uH and the drawn line is ~5-6 px thick; registration/frame error is <0.5 A equivalent. Digitized typical L values carry ~+/-2 uH uncertainty. These are typical-curve readings, NOT guaranteed limits.
digitization_method.validation: For 760800301 and 760801202 the digitized curve at the printed ISAT reads 0.698 and 0.687 of nominal L, matching the family's stated |dL/L|<30% saturation definition. For 760801403 (0.957) and 760801321 (0.805) the printed ISAT and the printed curve DISAGREE; both values are reported, neither is silently reconciled.

envelope_peak_vs_target.note: The envelope peak of 23.2719 A is the current at which the candidate's effective L is compared with the 357.528 uH target.

baseline_choke.manufacturer: Wurth Elektronik eiSos GmbH & Co. KG (Midcom)
baseline_choke.role: retained baseline; same envelope applied so the magnetic delta can be computed
baseline_choke.document_source: coordinator source bundle zapote/power-entry/loss-budget/sources/760800301.pdf (copy retained in raw/); hash matches bundle
baseline_choke.key_finding: The retained model's baseline 'effective inductance' is 180 uH (nominal rating). The datasheet's typical curve gives 159.8 uH at the envelope peak 23.27 A, i.e. the real part is ~11 % below the value the frequency trade assumed. This makes the baseline's true ripple at its own L (and 129 kHz) about 4.2043*180/159.8 = 4.736 A pk-pk, not the supplied 4.2043 A. Reported as a caution; the supplied envelope is used unchanged for the loss figures below.

loss_at_envelope.dc_copper_100c_basis: ASSUMED, NOT SOURCED: copper resistivity temp coefficient 0.00393 /K applied to the 20 C max DCR; datasheet publishes only a 20 C max.
loss_at_envelope.ac_winding_reason: Datasheet publishes no AC resistance / skin-proximity data at 65 kHz.
loss_at_envelope.core_reason: Datasheet publishes no core-loss data (page 2 gives only typical L vs current and typical dT vs current). Core loss is NOT inferred from DCR.
loss_at_envelope.dc_plus_ac_plus_core_reason: Only the DC copper term is sourced; AC winding and core loss are unpublished, so the total magnetic loss is null (unknown), not the DC number.

isat_curve_crosscheck.verdict: INCONSISTENT: |dL/L| < 30 % at 23 A would predict 248.5 uH, but the printed curve shows only -4.3 % at 23 A. The curve reaches -30 % of nominal near 36-37 A. Both the printed ISAT (23 A) and the curve-derived -30 % point (~37 A) are reported; the discrepancy is not resolved by this document. A conservative envelope check should use the printed ISAT 23 A, which is essentially equal to the 23.2719 A envelope peak -> NO saturation margin.

candidate_selection_note: Only the WE-TORPFC family was screened, because it is the family of the retained baseline and publishes the same L-vs-bias and dT-vs-current curves under the same conditions, which is what makes the delta comparable. max_candidate_parts = 3, so no fourth-vendor candidate was added. The three parts span the family near the target (389 uH / 355 uH / 720 uH nominal). No catalog candidate both (a) delivers ~357.5 uH at the 23.27 A bias and (b) meets the 15 A rms thermal envelope without forced air.
